notes: The hyphenated *to-night*, tokenized as t016 t017, is one English rendering covering the article and the noun (rule 30's one-rendering condition), headed on the lexeme-bearing morpheme; splitting it would leave *to* owned by no morpheme.
The impersonal *it was* of the Niphal realizes the verb's own 3ms person and number (rule 17), and the le of *told the king* is silenced by the bare-object recasting (rule 40).
